title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer (Claude Code / Codex)
description:
𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗦𝘂𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆:
 



 Build and run PetYosa's products end to end by directing AI coding agents — and prove every change works for a real customer before calling it done.
 



  





 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:
 



 PetYosa is a pet\-care platform in India: an app for pet parents, and software for the vets, groomers, boarding homes and pet shops who serve them.
 



 The unusual part. PetYosa's founder is not an engineer. In August 2026 alone, the founder made about 1,400 code changes to PetYosa's apps and servers — plus nearly 500 updates to its written operations playbooks — by directing AI coding agents through a strict build method.
 



 We are hiring engineers who can run that same method and bring real engineering judgement on top of it. This is a full\-time, office\-based role in Bangalore.
 



 The method you'll work in
 



 Every change goes: build → smoke test → adversarial review → fix → commit → push → merge → deploy from the merged commit → prove a customer can actually see it. A bug is never fixed for just one person — you find and fix every place the same problem exists.
 



  





 How we hire — no whiteboards, no puzzles
 



 • Short application (10 minutes). Your CV and answers are first checked automatically.
 



 • 6 online proctored tests — no AI, external monitor or screen sharing allowed, camera and microphone on (4 hours in total)
 



 • One/Two conversations
 



  





 All six tests are scored automatically. Test 1 usually reaches you within a few minutes of applying, though occasionally it takes longer. Each later test is emailed as soon as you pass the one before. Please check your spam folder too.
 



  





 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:
 



 • Own features end to end across the PetYosa consumer app, the partner platform (petyosasparsh.com), the admin console and the APIs behind them.
 



 • Testing what you are going to ship and what you shipped
 



 • Build with Claude Code and Codex as your primary tools, running several agents in different roles — one builds, one reviews, one attacks.
 



 • Run the method on every change, and close only on proof a customer can see — never on "merged" or "deployed".
 



 • When a bug is reported, find the whole class of it across the platform and fix it everywhere.
 



 • Keep the written playbooks current, in the same change as the work.
 



 • Write short, plain\-English updates the founder can act on.
 



  





 𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀:
 



 • You already build mostly by directing AI agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI) — and can show us something real you shipped that way.
 



 • Your reflex after "it works" is "now let me break it".
 



 • You can tell when an AI is confidently wrong, and you check before you trust.
 



 • You read TypeScript, React, Node, MongoDB/PostgreSQL and Docker well enough to judge what an agent wrote.
 



 • When someone says your fix didn't work, you verify before you defend.
 



 • You write plain English that a non\-technical founder can act on.
 



  





 What doesn't matter: your college, big\-company names, or algorithm puzzles.
 



  





 𝗣𝗿𝗲𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀:
 



 • Linux servers / hypervisors
 



 • Playwright / end\-to\-end testing
 



 • Mobile builds (Capacitor / Android)
 



 • Razorpay / WhatsApp Business API
 



  





 𝗧𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀 / 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗰𝗸:
 


* Claude Code / Codex CLI
* TypeScript, React, Node / Bun (Hono, Express)
* MongoDB, PostgreSQL / Supabase
* Capacitor (iOS / Android)
* Docker, Linux, git



  





 𝗖𝗧𝗖: INR 20,00,000 \- 24,00,000
 



 𝗩𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗣𝗮𝘆: Excellent Long\-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) for great candidates
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗝𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝗨𝘀:
 



 The method is already written down, so you'll spend your time shipping — not guessing how we work — and you'll build with AI agents every day.

title: Senior Engineer, API Network
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

****The Opportunity****
 API Network is a one stop solution for discovering, learning about, and using the APIs you need across public, internal and partner workspaces. Postman’s Public API Network is the world's largest network of public APIs. Private Network is a centralized, internal catalog that serves as an organization's single source of truth for corporate APIs, internal workspaces, collections, and environments.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Engineer (Full Stack) who thrives in building seamless, high\-performance user experiences and goes beyond silos to deliver value to the users. If you exhibit high ownership, have a bias for action, love solving complex problems, and are curious about products that are used by millions of developers, this role is for you!
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Shape the Future of APIs: Contribute to the development of cutting\-edge APIs and products in collaboration with a dynamic, cross\-functional team that includes Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers specializing in Support, Quality, Security, and Platform.
* Innovate Through Prototypes: Rapidly construct functional prototypes to address both internal and external use\-cases, driving our product’s evolution.
* Lead \& Mentor: Offer technical leadership and mentorship to your fellow engineers, sharing best practices and elevating our collective expertise.
* Shape Our Path: Be an integral contributor to roadmap planning, coordinating with all stakeholders to align our products with strategic goals.
* Own Systems Architecting: Lead the architecting and design of collection systems, partnering with stakeholders to ensure robust functionality and strategic integration.
* Enhance System Maturity: Take ownership of the maturation of existing systems, defining initiatives to enhance functionality, reliability, and performance.
* Drive Architectural Evolution: Identify and champion initiatives that drive architectural improvement and innovation.


****About You****
* Cloud and Distributed Systems Expert: You bring experience with cloud computing and distributed systems, having worked on customer\-facing systems at scale.
* Database Maestro: Your knowledge of database fundamentals and data storage principles is solid.
* Experienced Builder: With at least 6\+ years of experience building applications in high\-level programming languages \- especially Javascript. We primarily code in Javascript.
* Versatile Developer: A fair understanding of front\-end technologies, networking, analytics at a fundamental level, and proficiency in Backend engineering characterize your skill set.
* Passionate Technologist: You're driven by a passion for utilizing various tools and technologies to devise end\-to\-end solutions.
* Code Craftsperson: Your code is testable, maintainable, and easy to understand by others.
* Communicator: You can demystify technical concepts, effectively sharing knowledge with product managers, designers, support, and other engineers.
* Curious Learner: An insatiable curiosity moves you to understand how things work and to constantly learn, absorb, and share new knowledge.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

 When you work at this Company, your code ensures that schools are funded, infrastructure is planned, and public resources are optimized for an entire nation. This isn't just another SaaS product; it's the digital foundation of a society.

Our mission is direct and high\-stakes: we power the technology behind Norway’s public sector management. Our platform is the central nervous system for strategic planning and financial workflows for over 300 municipalities, enabling data\-driven decisions that impact the lives of 5\.4 million citizens.
 



  





 When you build here, your code ensures that schools are funded, infrastructure is planned, and public resources are optimized for an entire nation. This isn't just another SaaS product; it's the digital foundation of a society.
 



  





**The Role: Autonomy \& AI\-First Development** 




 We are moving past the era of "manual" coding. At this Company, you aren't just writing lines of code; you are orchestrating an AI\-driven factory. We expect you to be a power user of the AI\-native stack—Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and agentic frameworks.
 



  





 You won't spend your time on boilerplate. Instead, you will engineer the context, prompts, and architectural guardrails that allow AI agents to generate high\-quality, production\-ready systems. title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
**Company Description**
 Abstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI\-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack — from deploying and evaluating private and open\-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them.
   

  

 Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the
 **AI layer** 
 , focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the
 **application layer** 
 , focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities.
   

  

**The Context**
 AI models are only one part of a production AI system.
   

  

 They still need applications around them — APIs, workflows, user interfaces, authentication, databases, integrations, monitoring, and reliable production infrastructure.
   

  

 Our Software Engineering team owns this application layer.
   

  

 As we build more AI\-powered products, we are looking for engineers who want to become strong software developers while working close to modern AI systems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a
 **Software Engineering Intern** 
 , you will work primarily on the application layer of our AI products.
   

  

 You will build frontend and backend features, APIs, integrations, workflows, and other product components that connect with AI models and inference services.
   

  

 You will work with experienced engineers on real production systems using technologies such as
 **TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, and cloud services** 
 .
   

  

 You will also gain exposure to how systems such as LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and private model inference are integrated into production applications.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will be expected to write code, debug problems, understand the systems you are working on, and gradually take ownership of larger pieces of the product.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
 Depending on the project, you may work on:
   

  

* Building frontend and backend product features.
* Designing and consuming REST APIs and internal services.
* Working with databases, authentication, file storage, and third\-party integrations.
* Connecting applications with AI models, inference APIs, RAG systems, and AI agents.
* Debugging application issues across frontend, backend, and integrations.
* Writing tests and improving the reliability of existing features.
* Deploying and maintaining applications using cloud platforms and modern deployment tools.
* Reviewing your work with experienced engineers and improving it based on technical feedback.


 You will not be restricted to isolated internship exercises. The objective is for you to contribute to software that is actually being built and used.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 We care more about your engineering fundamentals and ability to learn than the number of frameworks listed on your resume.
   

  

**You should have:**
* Good programming fundamentals and problem\-solving ability.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language.
* Basic understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, and Git.
* Experience building at least one meaningful software project through coursework, a personal project, internship, hackathon, or similar work.
* Ability to understand existing code and make changes to it.
* Willingness to investigate problems instead of stopping at the first solution that appears to work.
* Ability to communicate clearly when you are stuck, disagree with an approach, or need more context.


 Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies will help, but we do not expect interns to already know our complete technology stack.
   

  

**Using AI as an Engineer**
 We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them.
   

  

 We do not evaluate engineers based on how much code they can type from memory.
   

  

 What matters is whether you can
 **understand the code you produce, question incorrect suggestions, test your implementation, debug failures, and explain the decisions you made.**
 AI can help you write code. You are still responsible for the result.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 This is
 **not an AI research or model\-training role** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be software and product engineering at the application layer.
   

  

 You will work close to our AI engineering team and gain visibility into model inference, RAG, agents, and Private AI infrastructure, but your core focus will be building the applications that make those capabilities useful.
   

  

 This is also not an internship where you spend your time only watching tutorials or completing disconnected training assignments.
   

  

 You will learn by working on real engineering problems with support from the team.
   

  

**Why Join Abstrabit**
 You will get the opportunity to build software in an environment where traditional application engineering and modern AI systems meet.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Work on real AI\-powered products rather than demo projects.
* Learn how production applications interact with private and open\-weight AI models.
* Work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations.
* Receive regular technical feedback and code reviews from experienced engineers.
* Gradually take ownership of larger features as your engineering ability improves.
* Get exposure to both the application engineering and AI engineering sides of modern AI systems.


 For engineers early in their careers, we believe understanding both sides will become increasingly valuable.
   

  

**Our Interview Process**
**Step 1: Application Screening \-** 
 We review basic eligibility, projects, and evidence that you have spent time building and experimenting with technology.
   

  

**Step 2: Practical Engineering Assessment \& Discussion \-** 
 You will work through a practical engineering problem and discuss your approach with one of our engineers.
   

  

 We may ask you to explain your solution, debug an issue, make a small change, or reason through an alternative approach. We are interested in how you use available tools, validate your work, and respond when something does not work as expected.
   

  

**Step 3 \- Final Conversation**
 A discussion about the role, your learning goals, expectations, and whether Abstrabit is the right environment for you.

description:
**About WeRize**




 Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintechplatform for 500 million underserved middle\-class customers who live in 5000\+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).
 



  





 This customer segmentis not served by privatesector banks, Insurersand Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket\-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans,savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support.These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000\+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.
 



  





 Our social distribution platform supported by financially literatefreelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on\-the\-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on\-fieldteams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That resultsin very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousandsof freelancers in 5000\+ citiesonly through its tech platform and without any feet\-on\-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.
 



  





 To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com

 **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer**

 into our core financial products to automate workflows, personalize user experiences, and enhance decision\-making systems.

* **Full\-Stack Architecture:**

* **Performance \& Reliability:** 
 Optimize application performance, system reliability, and database operations for scale.
* **Technical Leadership:** 
 Collaborate with product, design, and data science teams; mentor junior engineers and advocate best engineering practices.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 3\+ years of full\-stack software development experience.

 Strong proficiency in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern state management.
* **Backend:**

title: Software Engineer (Fullstack), Collections
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**About Us**
 The Collections team owns some of the most foundational features of the Postman platform like Collections, Documentation, and Version Control. These are the building blocks that developers around the world rely on every day to design, test, and deploy APIs. The services powering these features operate at massive scale, and with that scale comes a constant stream of hard engineering problems, from data consistency and storage efficiency to system reliability and performance under heavy load. In addition, the team works on evolving the product through new features shaped by real user needs.
   

  

****The Role****
 We're looking for a Software Engineer who is energized by the challenges that come with scale. If you enjoy solving complex problems that don't have easy answers, have a bias for action, and want to help shape how a high\-scale platform is engineered end to end, this role is for you. You'll also help shape where the product goes next, building experiences used by millions of developers.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Own and build secure, performant, and scalable end\-to\-end experiences for Postman, tackling day\-to\-day challenges around scale, performance, and reliability.
* Work with agility. Move quickly, make pragmatic trade\-offs, and iterate fast to deliver incremental improvements.
* Improve quality and reliability by strengthening test pipelines, and proactively addressing bottlenecks and technical debt.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver solutions that meet both technical and user needs.
* Help define and drive engineering best practices including code quality, system design standards, and operational excellence, while contributing to the engineering culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring peers.
* Contribute to new features and product improvements driven by user needs and innovation, including quickly building functional prototypes for internal and external use\-cases.


****What We’re Looking For****
* 2\-4 years of experience, with a track record of building and shipping features at scale.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js and databases (SQL/NoSQL) which preferably includes query optimization and schema design.
* Strong Computer Science fundamentals \- algorithms, networking, and operating systems, along with a genuine curiosity for solving scale\-related challenges.
* A strong sense of ownership and agility. You see problems through from design to production and get things done even under ambiguity or constraints.
* A collaborative mindset. You communicate well, work confidently across teams, and can challenge stakeholders like PMs and EMs when needed.
* An appreciation for product thinking. You love translating user needs into technical solutions and building things that create real value for users.
* A commitment to writing testable, maintainable code, paired with a curiosity to learn new things and explore beyond silos.


****Why Join Us?****
* Build for millions. Work on a high\-velocity team shaping the systems that power Postman for developers around the world.
* Solve problems that actually matter. Scale, reliability, distributed systems \- every day brings a new challenge worth sinking your teeth into.
* Own it, end to end. Be part of a culture that values curiosity, ownership, trust, and winning together, even under constraints.
* We've got you covered. Competitive salary and benefits, a flexible schedule, and real room to grow.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

**What You’ll Do**

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**About Runable** 




 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. We ship fast, own our work end to end, and measure success by what our customers actually get done.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring an Engineering Lead who is a backend\-heavy full stack builder. You will own services end to end: data model, API, business logic, background jobs, and the React screens that sit on top of them. Roughly 70% of your time is backend and systems work, 30% frontend.
 



 This is a builder role, not a ticket\-taking role. You will be given a problem and the context around it, and you are expected to come back with a design, ship it, and stand behind it in production.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, build, and operate backend services and REST/JSON APIs that power customer\-facing products.
* Own data modeling and database work in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.
* Build asynchronous and event\-driven flows: background jobs, queues, retries, idempotency, and scheduled work.
* Integrate third\-party systems (payments, email, CRM, messaging, LLM providers) with sane error handling and rate\-limit behavior.
* Build the frontend for the features you own in React and TypeScript — clean, fast, accessible screens, not throwaway UI.
* Instrument what you ship: logging, metrics, alerts, and dashboards, so failures are visible before customers report them.
* Improve reliability and performance — find the slow query, the N\+1, the memory leak, the cache that should exist, and fix it.
* Review peers' code, write the design docs that matter, and keep the codebase something the next engineer can work in.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for the services you own, and drive incident follow\-ups to closure.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5–9 years of professional software engineering experience, with the majority of it on backend systems.
* Strong command of at least one backend language used in production at scale — TypeScript/Node.js preferred; strong Python, Go, or Java experience with willingness to work primarily in TypeScript is welcome.
* Deep, practical PostgreSQL (or comparable relational database) experience: you can explain a query plan, design a schema for a real product, and migrate it safely with live traffic.
* Proven experience designing and shipping APIs consumed by real clients — versioning, pagination, auth, error contracts.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend fundamentals: component structure, state management, forms, and API integration.
* Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar), containers, CI/CD, and deploying your own code.
* Solid grasp of caching, queues, and background processing (Redis, SQS/Kafka/BullMQ or equivalents).
* Testing discipline — unit and integration tests, and a clear view of what is worth testing.
* Strong debugging skills in production environments and the judgment to know when to patch versus when to fix properly.
* Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a non\-engineer.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a startup or on a small team where you owned a service end to end.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS experience — tenancy models, per\-tenant limits, billing, and usage metering.
* Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or workflow automation in production.
* Payments and subscription billing (Stripe or similar).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry, Datadog).
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**Timeframe** 




**Expected outcome** 




 First 30 days
 



 Environment set up, first features shipped to production, familiar with the core data model and services.
 



 First 60 days
 



 Owning a service or product area end to end, contributing to design reviews, closing reliability gaps you found yourself.
 



 First 90 days
 



 Leading delivery of a significant backend project, measurably improving performance or reliability of the area you own, and raising the bar in code review.
 



  





**Our Stack** 




 TypeScript across the stack, Node.js/Bun services, PostgreSQL, Redis, React, REST APIs, Docker, and cloud\-hosted infrastructure with CI/CD. We are pragmatic about tools — the right choice is the one the team can operate at 3am.
 



  





**Why Runable** 



* Real ownership: you pick the design, ship it, and see the customer impact within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — your work reaches SMB customers who feel the difference immediately.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

title: AI & Full Stack Engineer – Paid Internship
description:
Build at the frontier of AI 🧠
 



  





 Even the best\-run companies struggle for answers they can trust. Unloq fixes that. Period. Answers in seconds, in plain language, with the evidence behind every number. Live with enterprise customers, we're now building towards prescriptive intelligence: not just what happened, but what to do next.
 



 Come build the next big AI platform with us!
 



  





 We're looking for a one of a kind Full Stack AI Engineer: someone who can take a client problem nobody has solved before, a messy data environment, a workflow held together by spreadsheets and goodwill, and ship a production AI system that people actually rely on. You'll work directly with the founders and the engineering team, owning client delivery end\-to\-end.
 



  





 The way software gets built changed. We build like it. This is agentic engineering, not ticket\-taking. Anyone can prompt a model. We want someone who directs Claude Code across parallel workstreams, reads every line it produces, and knows exactly when the machine is wrong. You'll ship in days what used to take teams a quarter, and you'll be the deepest engineer in the room when it counts.
 



  





**🔑 The Role** 




 You'll own the journey from client requirement to production system.
 


* Designing, building and deploying LLM\-powered conversational systems: chatbots, workflow assistants and domain\-specific AI tools (including patient\-facing systems), tailored to each client's data and domain
* Full\-stack ownership: backend (FastAPI/Python), frontend integration, LLM orchestration and production deployment. If it ships to a client, it's yours
* Engineering the LLM layer properly: inference pipelines, context management, evals, caching and cost\-efficient model routing. Prompt engineering is table stakes; we expect pipeline thinking
* Connecting AI to the real world: client APIs, webhooks, MCP servers and event\-driven automations that remove manual work rather than add to it
* Production\-grade by default: Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, drift detection, testing and documentation on every engagement. Demos are easy; reliability is the product
* Sitting in client rooms: translating requirements into technical specs, shipping weekly demos, escalating scope creep early, and feeding what you learn back into the platform



  





**⚙️ How We Work** 



* All code is reviewed before it merges. Architectural decisions sit with the Principal AI / Systems Architect; implementation decisions are yours
* Client delivery code lives in client\-specific repositories, separate from the core platform
* Weekly standup with the founding team, daily async updates in Slack
* Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot aren't tolerated here, they're expected. If you're not building agentically, you're building slowly



  





**📦 What You'll Have Built** 




 In your first six months:
 


* Two or more production AI systems live with enterprise clients, from first discovery call to deployment
* A reusable delivery stack: orchestration patterns, eval harnesses and deployment templates so no engagement starts from a blank repo
* A monitoring and validation layer that catches drift and quality issues before the client does
* Documentation and handover packs that make every deployment maintainable without you
* A weekly shipping cadence clients set their watch by



  





**🧩 Who This Is For** 



* A strong T1 technical degree, with an Master's in an AI native program preferred. We hire on evidence, not just pedigree
* Serious Python and full\-stack fundamentals. Non\-negotiable, and how we'll assess you. You'll be handed a real problem and a hard time limit
* Native to agentic development: Claude Code or similar as your primary way of building, with the depth to review, correct and harden everything it generates
* Production LLM experience: you've shipped something real on model APIs and you understand context management, token economics, latency and failure modes
* DevOps competence: Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment (AWS preferred)
* Client\-ready communication. You can explain a technical trade\-off to a non\-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down or drowning them
* You own delivery and keep momentum without being chased
* Nice to have: RAG and retrieval systems, MCP, eval frameworks, event\-driven architecture, exposure to healthcare or other regulated industries



  





**📍Role Basics** 



* Role: Full Stack AI Engineer (Full\-time)
* Location: Fully Remote, Start ASAP
* Compensation: $250pm with a world\-class mentorship program and the real prospect of a FT role



  





**Why Join Unloq®?** 



* Learn from the best. You'll work directly with the founders on live enterprise deployments, and grow faster than any grad scheme would allow
* Real craft, real ownership. Your code ships to paying enterprise clients. There is no layer between your work and the outcome it drives
* Direct founder access. Small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy
* Modern stack. Claude and Claude Code at the core, Databricks underneath, ClickUp for delivery
* We're building something that doesn't exist yet: the layer that makes AI trustworthy enough for the boardroom, not just the back office. It's early, it's hard, and the right people find that exciting. If you take pride in flawless execution done properly, this is your role.



  





 Unloq is an equal opportunities employer. We hire on talent and potential, and we welcome applicants from every background and route into the industry. If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply anyway.

title: Java Lead
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

  

  





**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**
  

  

  

 With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.
   

  

  

  

 The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.
   

  

  

  

 You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

  

  

 This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: SpringBoot Integration - Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SpringBoot Integration \- Senior Associate, you will engage in the design and development of innovative software solutions within our Technology Consulting practice. You will work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions that drive business success. This role involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to integrate and implement software systems that enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your problem\-solving skills and critical thinking to navigate complex challenges and deliver quality work. You will build meaningful client relationships and develop a deeper understanding of the business context. This position offers the chance to mentor junior team members, guiding them in their professional growth while maintaining professional and technical standards.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to work within our Digital Integration \& Architecture sector, contributing to the development of cutting\-edge software engineering solutions. Your contributions will be instrumental in driving client success and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Developing and integrating software solutions using Spring Boot and microservices architecture
* Managing application lifecycle and implementing continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices
* Conducting code reviews and maintaining coding standards to enhance software quality
* Collaborating with clients to analyze business requirements and deliver tailored solutions
* Utilizing programming languages such as Java, Python, and JavaScript for software development and troubleshooting
* Designing and implementing enterprise application integration strategies to optimize system performance
* Leading software testing and debugging processes to identify and resolve issues efficiently
* Applying analytical thinking and business process improvement techniques to enhance client outcomes
* Building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders to support client management and project success
* Promoting innovation and embracing change within software engineering teams


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SpringBoot Integration Associate, you will be at the forefront of developing innovative software solutions that drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your technical skills and creative thinking to design, code, and test applications that revolutionize industries and deliver exceptional user experiences. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements, developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will apply a learning mindset and take ownership of your development, appreciating diverse perspectives and adopting habits to sustain performance. You will actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas. By gathering information from various sources, you will analyze facts and discern patterns, committing to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness. You will learn and apply professional and technical standards, upholding the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Developing innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance
* Designing, coding, and testing applications using Java, Spring Boot, and other programming languages
* Collaborating with team members and clients to gather requirements and deliver exceptional user experiences
* Applying knowledge of software development methodologies, including Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
* Conducting code reviews and debugging to maintain quality software standards
* Utilizing API Management and Enterprise Application Integration to streamline processes and improve functionality
* Engaging in business process improvement and management to optimize software solutions
* Participating in software project planning and management to validate timely delivery and alignment with client needs
* Building a personal brand by consistently delivering quality work and contributing to team success


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Event\-driven architecture and service orchestration, Integration
* REST API design and consumption (HTTP methods, endpoints, status codes)
* Authentication patterns: OAuth2, API Key, Basic Auth
* JOLT transformation for JSON payload mapping and reshaping
* Service type configuration: REST, SOAP, DB2, MQ


 Apache Avro schema design
   

  

* Exception handling: retry strategies, compensatory event maps ,DLQ (Dead Letter Queue) analysis and failure diagnosis
* Trigger pattern configuration: sync and async\- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
* Demonstrating proficiency in Spring Boot and Java programming
* Utilizing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) methodologies
* Applying knowledge of microservices architecture and API management
* Excelling in client management and communication skills
* Developing skills in software troubleshooting and debugging
* Engaging in business process improvement and requirements analysis

title: Client Technology-Engineering-Software Engineering
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**The opportunity**
* Leads the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for a large or more complex project, using strong technical capabilities and outstanding hands\-on experience!
* Takes accountability for the design, development, delivery and maintenance of solutions or infrastructure, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards
* Fully understands business and user requirements and ensures design specifications meet the requirements from a business and technical perspective


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Solves complex and escalated aspects of a project, performing coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process
* Provides advanced technical expertise to maximize efficiency, reliability and value from current solutions, infrastructure and emerging technologies, showing technical leadership and identifying and implementing continuous improvement plans
* Develops strong working relationships with peers across Development \& Engineering and Architecture teams, collaborating to develop and engineer leading solutions
* Provides a leadership role for the work group, ensuring the appropriate expectations, principles, structures, tools and responsibilities are in place to deliver the project
* Drives consistency to the relevant processes, procedures, standards, technical design whilst supporting the definition, maintenance and implementation of technology standard


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Advanced technical proficiency in designing, developing, and debugging solutions
* Advanced knowledge of one or more of: C\#/Java or Python
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics, or related field preferred
* More than 10 years applied experience
* Significant relevant experience in either an internal or external software or platform engineering role, or similar
* Technical knowledge and experience in delivering software / platform engineering solutions (depending on specialism), providing comprehensive technical advice and handling user requirements

title: Solution Architect - Full Stack and AI
description:
Job Description: Solution Architect \- Full Stack and AI
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on Solution Architect with a strong full\-stack development background and experience building AI\-powered product features.
 



  





 The role will own enterprise solution delivery from requirement discovery and architecture design through development, integration, deployment, and production stabilization. This is not a documentation\-only architecture role. The candidate should be comfortable reviewing code, building prototypes, solving integration issues, and guiding engineering teams through implementation.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Understand business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
* Own solution delivery from discovery through production rollout.
* Design scalable full\-stack applications, enterprise integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI\-enabled features.
* Define system architecture, application components, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment models.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concept solutions for complex integrations and AI use cases.
* Work closely with frontend, backend, AI, DevOps, and customer technology teams.
* Review code, architecture decisions, API contracts, database models, and implementation approaches.
* Design integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, event\-driven systems, message queues, and scheduled processes.
* Build or guide the development of AI features such as conversational interfaces, document processing, intelligent search, recommendations, copilots, and workflow automation.
* Design secure and reliable integrations with enterprise systems and third\-party platforms.
* Define authentication, authorization, data transformation, error handling, retries, monitoring, and audit logging.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and scalability constraints early in the delivery cycle.
* Support testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and post\-production stabilization.
* Create reusable architecture patterns, components, integration templates, and engineering standards.



 Required Experience
 



  




* Strong experience as a Full Stack Developer, Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or Engineering Lead.
* Hands\-on experience building and delivering production\-grade web applications.
* Strong frontend experience with React,Next.js, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
* Strong backend experience with Node.js, Python, Java, or similar server\-side technologies.
* Experience designing REST APIs, microservices, databases, authentication systems, and distributed applications.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms, third\-party applications, and external APIs.



  




* Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered features using large language models or machine learning services.
* Experience working with LLM APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval\-based systems, or agentic workflows.
* Understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, caching, queues, and search systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of Docker, CI/CD, application monitoring, and production deployment.
* Ability to translate business requirements into executable technical plans.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.



  





 Preferred Experience
 



  




* Experience building enterprise SaaS products or internal business platforms.
* Experience with HRMS,ERP, CRM, payroll, workforce management, finance, or operations systems.
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, RAG pipelines, or document intelligence.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks and agent development patterns.
* Experience with API gateways, middleware, iPaaS platforms, or event\-streaming systems.
* Understanding of data privacy, access control, encryption, auditability, and enterprise security.
* Experience leading small engineering teams or coordinating delivery across multiple technical teams.



  





 Expected Technical Profile
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to:
 



  




* Design the complete solution architecture.
* Build or review front end and backend components.
* Create APIs and integration services.
* Prototype AI\-powered product features.
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs.
* Debug issues across the full application stack.
* Guide developers during implementation.
* Work directly with customers and enterprise technology teams.
* Take technical ownership until the solution is successfully deployed.



  





 Success Measures
 



  




* Solutions are delivered within agreed scope and timelines.
* Architecture decisions translate cleanly into working software.
* AI features are useful, reliable, secure, and production\-ready.
* Integrations remain scalable and maintainable after deployment.
* Technical risks and delivery blockers are identified early.
* Engineering teams receive clear implementation direction.
* Production issues are minimized and resolved quickly.



  





 Education
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent hands\-on engineering and product\-building experience will also be considered.

description:
**About Airbound**
**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**
 This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.
   

  

 The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.
   

  

 To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.
   

  

**About Flight Systems**
 The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather\-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry\-leading payload\-to\-weight ratio of \~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting\-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real\-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don't have textbook solutions, this is your playground.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join our team dedicated to developing a suite of sophisticated, web\-based platforms for UAV operations. This role is central to building the software that powers our entire ecosystem, including our next\-generation Ground Control Station (GCS), fleet management dashboards, data analysis tools, and simulation interfaces. This position is integral to our core mission, contributing directly to the safety and efficiency of our real\-world autonomous operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Platform Development: Architect, develop, and deploy robust, end\-to\-end features across our various web\-based UAV platforms
* Front\-End Engineering: Construct dynamic and highly responsive user interfaces using React for the visualization of real\-time telemetry, interactive mission planning, and complex data analysis
* Back\-End Engineering: Engineer high\-throughput, low\-latency backend services using NestJS to reliably process UAV data streams, manage command\-and\-control logic, and parse specialized communication protocols
* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Actively participate in all phases of the agile software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
* Software Excellence: Champion and adhere to software development best practices, including Test\-Driven Development (TDD), to ensure exceptional code quality, system reliability, and performance in a mission\-critical environment
* Technical Documentation: Create and maintain clear, concise technical documentation for the systems and features you develop, including architectural diagrams, API specifications, and operational runbooks
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions


**Qualifications**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* A minimum of 7\+ years of professional experience in full\-stack software development, preferably with exposure to real\-time systems
* Front\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with demonstrated experience building complex, data\-driven user interfaces
* Back\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in backend development with Node.js and extensive hands\-on experience with the NestJS framework
* Database Systems: Hands\-on experience with both SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization
* Networking: A strong understanding of core networking principles, including the TCP/IP suite and UDP, with practical experience implementing real\-time communication using WebSockets
* Data Stream Processing: Experience developing systems that process and manage continuous, high\-frequency data streams
* Software Engineering Fundamentals:
+ Strong test\-driven development and profiling expertise for safety\-critical systems
+ Mastery of Git workflows and collaborative development practices

+ Excellent documentation and communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration


 Good to Have

* Data Pipelines: Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) or time\-series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)

description:

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Employment Type:**

**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Full Stack Developer – AI/LLM Applications** 
 to build and operate product features end\-to\-end.
 



  





 You will own features across
 **frontend, backend, databases, AI/LLM integrations, testing, deployment and production support** 
 . The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of a feature from an incomplete requirement through development, release and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Mandatory:** 
**Hands\-on experience integrating AI or LLM services into production applications is required. Candidates with only academic, experimental or personal\-project experience with AI/LLMs will not be considered.** 




  





 You should understand that building an AI feature involves more than connecting an API. It requires structured outputs, validation, evaluation, error handling, security, monitoring and cost management.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Design and build responsive web applications using
 **React.js, Next.js or similar frameworks** 
 .
* Develop backend services and REST APIs using
 **Node.js, Express.js or similar technologies** 
 .
* Own features from technical design through development, testing, deployment and production monitoring.
* Design data models and queries for
 **SQL or NoSQL databases** 
 .
* Integrate external APIs with authentication, validation, retries, rate\-limit handling and logging.
* Build AI\-assisted features using
 **LLM APIs, embeddings, retrieval, tool calling or workflow orchestration** 
 .
* Implement prompt versioning, structured responses, output validation, guardrails and fallback mechanisms.
* Evaluate AI output quality and monitor latency, token usage and cost.
* Write and maintain
 **unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests** 
 .
* Investigate production issues, identify root causes and implement reliable fixes.
* Improve application performance, reliability, security and observability.
* Review code and contribute to technical architecture and release decisions.
* Work closely with product, design, QA and engineering teams to resolve requirements and delivery risks.



  





**Required Experience** 




  




* **3–4 years of full\-stack development experience.**
* Strong fundamentals in
 **JavaScript and TypeScript** 
 .
* Production experience with
 **React.js, Next.js or a similar frontend framework** 
 .
* Production experience with
 **Node.js, Express.js and REST APIs** 
 .
* Experience with
 **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or a similar database** 
 .
* **Hands\-on experience integrating AI or LLM services into production applications or workflows.**
* Understanding of
 **prompt design, structured outputs, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails and human review** 
 .
* Experience with Git, automated testing, application security, deployment and production debugging.
* Ability to convert incomplete requirements into a technical plan and deliver with limited supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  




* Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* SaaS, workflow or enterprise application development.
* Vector databases and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* LLM observability or evaluation frameworks.
* Queue\-based processing, caching or event\-driven systems.



  





**Ownership Expectations** 




  





 At Troopd, you will be responsible for the
 **outcome of a feature, not just its implementation** 
 .
 



 This includes understanding requirements, documenting technical trade\-offs, identifying failure cases, coordinating dependencies, shipping safely, monitoring production behaviour and following through on issues after release.
 



  





**Why Troopd?** 




  





 Troopd is building
 **Agentic Colleagues** 
 that take ownership of defined business roles and execute the work associated with them.
 



  





 You will be joining at an
 **early stage** 
 , where the engineering team has a direct impact on the product, architecture and technology choices. You will work on real AI\-powered business applications, solve practical engineering problems and see your work move from idea to production.
 



  





 If you enjoy
 **building products end\-to\-end, working with modern AI/LLM technologies and taking real ownership** 
 , this is an opportunity to build something from the ground up.
 



  





**Apply if you have actually shipped AI/LLM\-powered functionality in production and want to build the next generation of AI\-native business applications.**

 At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1\.5 billion\+ downloads alongside a thriving PC \& Console division that has achieved numerous global chart\-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists.  At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door\-to\-door transport scheme, free food \& drinks, free game codes \& merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days \+ bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5\.
   

  

**Join the team!**
 As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a
 **Senior Fullstack Developer** 
 to join our AI \& Technology team.
   

  

 As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be responsible for building and shipping fullstack applications end to end. This role expands our senior depth to support our AI and Infrastructure work. You'll help fellow engineers get unblocked, lend a hand with DevOps and deployments, and deliver features acoss the stack that move the wider business forwatds.
   

  

 This is a permanent role based in our Bangalore studio, where our daily in\-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design, build, and ship complete features across Python/FastAPI backends and React frontends.
* Build and maintain asynchronous APIs in Python and FastAPI, backed by sensible database design and secure server\-side logic.
* Deploy and harden containerised microservices with Docker so they hold up in production.
* Build frontends using Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript, with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and TanStack (React Query) for state.
* Integrate third\-party AI services such as the OpenAI APIs into live web applications.
* Make effective use of agentic coding tools like GitHub Copilot in VS Code to work faster without cutting corners on quality.
* Track down architectural issues and performance bottlenecks across the stack and fix them.
* Write and maintain tests to keep the codebase reliable as it grows.
* Review other developers' code and give clear, constructive feedback.
* Keep technical documentation up to date so the team can find what they need.
* Write clean, maintainable code that others on the team can build on.
* Work with our AI Engineers to stand up and stabilise the infrastructure behind new tools in the PCC and Mobile space.
* Support the DevOps team, helping keep our AWS environments and deployment pipelines in good shape as demand grows.
* Mentor fellow developers and share what you know as the team grows.
* Pitch in within a flat team structure, unblocking others and keeping delivery moving.
* Weigh in on decisions about scalability and how our systems should grow, without carrying formal management responsibility.
* Report to the Head of Engineering all relevant matters that affect your job and work.
* Fully comply with the companies procedures, processes, strategies and tactics as may be issued from time to time.
* Ad\-hoc other tasks which may arise from time to time and be assigned to you by the business.


**Fullstack Technical Expertise:**
* At least 5 years building asynchronous APIs with Python and FastAPI.
* A solid grasp of database design, secure server\-side logic, and keeping data intact.
* Experience deploying and running containerised microservices with Docker in production.
* Familiarity with Cloud hosting, deployment, and cloud infrastructure, AWS desirable.
* Comfortable working with Git in a collaborative, review\-based workflow.
* Hands\-on with agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot in VS Code as part of your day\-to\-day workflow.
* Strong React skills, specifically Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript.
* Comfortable with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn, and managing state with TanStack (React Query).
* Hands\-on experience wiring third\-party AI services like the OpenAI APIs into live applications


**Ownership \& Delivery:**
* You can dig into architectural issues and performance bottlenecks and sort them out.
* You write tests and review others' code as a matter of habit, not an afterthought.
* You deliver steadily and to a good standard while working across time zones with the rest of the team.
* You've shipped features end to end across both Python and React, not just one side of the stack.


**Mentorship and Cross\-Team Collaboration:**
* You enjoy coaching other developers and levelling up the people around you, without needing to be their manager.
* You're happy to help out with DevOps and infrastructure alongside your own work.
* You can talk through trade\-offs on scalability and design clearly, with both engineers and leadership.
* You care about clean, maintainable code and work in a way that lifts the whole team.


**Why Kwalee?**
* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food \& Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget\-friendly, door\-to\-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year\-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch \& Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.


**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**
 At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
   

  

 We recognise the importance of self\-development, career progression, and well\-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
